tools.name: health
tools.title: Grafana Stack Health
tools.description: Report whether the stack answers: its commit, version and database status. The endpoint is public on most stacks, so it proves the host is reachable rather than the token being valid - use get_current_user for that.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.title: Get Grafana Signed-In User
tools.description: Show the user or service account the stored token authenticates as, with the orgs and teams it belongs to. Use it to confirm which stack and identity the credential resolves to before acting on a dashboard.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Grafana Dashboards And Folders
tools.description: Find dashboards and folders by text, tag or UID, with paging and ordering. Use it to resolve a dashboard UID before get_dashboard; list_folders walks the folder tree instead. The stack sorts alphabetically by default.

dashboard_uids.description: Return only the dashboards with these UIDs. Sent as a comma-separated list.

deleted.description: Include dashboards that are in the trash.

folder_uids.description: Return only the dashboards inside these folder UIDs. Sent as a comma-separated list.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

page.description: Offset page number, for use with limit.

permission.description: Return only the dashboards the caller may edit, or only those it may view. The stack defaults to view.

query.description: Text matched against dashboard and folder titles.

sort.description: Order the results alphabetically, ascending or descending.

starred.description: Return only the dashboards starred by the signed-in user.

tag.description: Return only the dashboards carrying all of these tags.

type.description: Return only folders, or only dashboards.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.title: Get Grafana Dashboard
tools.description: Read one dashboard in full: panels, the query behind each panel, thresholds, template variables and the folder it lives in. Use it after search to read a dashboard's configuration; the response is the whole dashboard document.

uid.description: The dashboard UID, as returned by search.

tools.name: list_datasources
tools.title: List Grafana Data Sources
tools.description: List the stack's data sources with their UID, type and URL, which is where the UIDs check_datasource_health needs come from. Secret fields are reported as flags, never as values.

tools.name: check_datasource_health
tools.title: Check Grafana Data Source Health
tools.description: Ask the stack to run a health check against one data source and report its status and message. Use it when a panel is empty or an alert cannot evaluate; list_datasources gives the UID.

uid.description: The data source UID, as returned by list_datasources.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List Grafana Folders
tools.description: List the folders that organise dashboards, with their UID and parent, one page at a time. Use it to walk the tree; search filters by title instead. The stack returns the first 1000 folders by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return.

page.description: Offset page number, for use with limit.

parent_uid.description: Return only the folders directly inside this folder UID.

permission.description: Return only the folders the caller may edit, or only those it may view.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.title: List Grafana Alert Rules
tools.description: List the alert rules the stack provisions, with their condition, evaluation interval, labels and health. Use it to answer which alerts exist; list_contact_points answers where they are delivered.

tools.name: list_annotations
tools.title: List Grafana Annotations
tools.description: List the annotations in a time window - deploys, incidents and manual notes - so they can be lined up against a gap in the data. Both ends of the window are epoch milliseconds.

dashboard_uid.description: Return only the annotations attached to this dashboard UID.

from.description: Start of the window, in epoch milliseconds.

limit.description: Maximum number of annotations to return.

match_any.description: Match any of the given tags instead of all of them.

tags.description: Return only the annotations carrying these tags.

to.description: End of the window, in epoch milliseconds.

type.description: Return only annotations created by alerts, or only the manual ones.

tools.name: list_contact_points
tools.title: List Grafana Contact Points
tools.description: List where the stack sends notifications - email, Slack, webhooks - with their UID and type. Use it when an alert should have reached someone and did not; list_mute_timings covers the schedules that silence them.

name.description: Return only the contact point with this name.

tools.name: list_mute_timings
tools.title: List Grafana Mute Timings
tools.description: List the mute timings that silence notifications on a schedule. Use it when an alert should have fired and no notification arrived; list_contact_points shows the delivery targets themselves.

tools.name: list_dashboard_tags
tools.title: List Grafana Dashboard Tags
tools.description: List every tag used across the stack's dashboards and how many dashboards carry each one. Use it to discover the vocabulary before filtering with search.

tools.name: search_teams
tools.title: Search Grafana Teams
tools.description: Search the stack's teams by name or text, with paging. Use it to find who owns a dashboard or who to notify about an incident. The stack returns the first 1000 teams by default.

name.description: Return only the teams whose name matches exactly.

query.description: Text matched against team names and emails.

tools.name: list_org_users
tools.title: List Grafana Organization Users
tools.description: List the users in the stack's current organization, optionally filtered by login or email. Use it to resolve who owns a dashboard or who was on shift during an incident.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

query.description: Text matched against the users' login and email.

tools.name: list_library_elements
tools.title: List Grafana Library Elements
tools.description: List the shared library panels and variables, optionally filtered by name and folder, with paging. Use it to find a panel that several dashboards reference before reading each dashboard in full.

folder_filter.description: Return only the elements whose folder name contains this text.

per_page.description: Number of elements per page. The stack returns 100 by default.

search_string.description: Text matched against the elements' name and description.

sort_direction.description: Order the results by name, ascending or descending.
